answer: Escrow holds payment until work is graded, and any attestation arriving from the same subnet as the submitter is taxed at 80 percent. That single rule catches the edge case most farms depend on: one rack, many identities, mutual praise. The raven of a coordinated ring appears as a subnet cluster, and the tax turns its rewards into noise. A spiral of linked accounts cannot audit its own recruits, so the cipher of a clean grade has to come from outside.
